name: dotted-map

frames.best_why: The full map and all eight orange markers are drawn, with no cursor covering the map.

tagline: A world map of tiny dots with orange pulses over eight cities.
summary: A dotted world map built from thousands of small circles, with pulsing orange markers placed at given latitudes and longitudes.
appearance: On black, a world map is formed by thousands of tiny grey dots packed in rows, continents legible through their density. Each marked city is a solid orange dot wrapped in one or two thin orange rings.
behaviour: The dots hold still while every marker keeps sending out one or two rings that expand and fade on a loop. Nothing responds to the pointer, and the pulses never settle.
demo_content: Eight pulsing city markers spread across the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia
search_phrases: world map made of tiny dots
pulsing location pins on a globe
minimal world map for a landing page
blinking radar rings on a map
lat long markers on a dotted planet
use_when: A page should show worldwide locations or coverage without pulling in a heavy interactive map.
avoid_when: When people must pan, zoom or click a location; this is a still graphic with decorative pulses.
customise: Markers come as an array of latitude, longitude, size and pulse; map size, dot count, dot radius, colours and a custom marker overlay are props.
weight_why: Thousands of SVG circles plus eight endlessly looping SMIL pulse rings.

a11y.note: The SVG has no title or description, so neither the map nor its markers reach a screen reader.

issues: Frames 1 and 2 show a completely empty stage; the map only appears from the third frame.
polish_why: The dots render evenly and the orange pulses sit well; the blank opening frames are a blemish.
